directions.criterion: two failed states, repeated rho >= .02, improvement above 0.1% of initial loss and 5% of the baseline reduction

hybrid-full.criterion: recover an original Raw failure and improve on same-mapping FD, retaining original successes

hybrid-small.criterion: hybrid gains a recovery without losses, or both baseline cases reach 1cm/1% and a hybrid also passes both

neighbourhood.criterion: preserve the same Raw recovery successes at 2/5/10 cm and on the pure-position case

screen.criteria: successes, training display NRMSE, scaled parameter error, optimization cameras

gates.structured-on-skipped: both isolation floors changed per-light shadow allocation
gates.soft-to-hard-skipped: Soft XYZ brought no parameter recovery on the original Hard objective
gates.c-independent-skipped: no compressed mapping improved on Raw and preserved its success
